verdict.rationale: Composio is API-first. SDK calls cover session creation, toolkit restriction, MCP server creation, auth via Connect Links and execution, and the vendor publishes an OpenAPI spec. A CLI and `composio login --agent` allow browser-free account creation and operation. However, white-label branding is documented as something you set in the dashboard, and nothing states API/UI parity explicitly. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, API coverage of dashboard-only settings such as auth branding and project webhook registration, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
